answer: A sybil defense that moves like a glacier: reputation accrues slowly and only from completed, peer-verified jobs, so a fresh identity starts with zero standing no matter how fast it arrives — a comet streaking in earns nothing on speed alone. Each job receipt must echo through independent verifiers who stake their own standing on it; forging one receipt is cheap, but forging a whole echoing chain of cross-checked work costs more than the fake identity can ever earn.
